description: Beech 18 / C-45 rescued from the old Jeddah Kandara airport after its 1981 closure and mounted on a pole at a roundabout in Jeddah (legendarymilavia blog, May 2019). aerialvisuals maps a Beech 18 at 21.50179 39.20362 on King Khalid Street, Al Faiha'a, close to the old airport site. Identity unknown; current presence not confirmed after 2019.
